payload_note: Promoted on 2026-05-24 as the primary Group A runtime payload after cap-0.20 re-optimization and replay validation. This payload keeps the same checkpoint, lowers the 00631L leverage cap from 0.30 to 0.20, improves recent-window drawdown and Sharpe relative to cap-0.30, and remains stronger on the 2008-style crash proxy. Historical cap-0.30 artifacts are retained for comparison.

group_a_llm_sentiment_config.note: Daily market-level LLM sentiment features are merged into Group A shared market state and also drive a sentiment risk gate that can neutralize 00631L or enable 00632R defense.

group_a_sentiment_gate_config.note: LLM sentiment remains defensive by default. Positive leverage boost support exists, but the validated release keeps it disabled after runtime sweep degradation.

group_b_sentiment_gate_config.note: Sentiment gate is disabled because Group B LLM sentiment is disabled.

group_a_pva_sigmoid_config.note: Defensive cap-0.20 runtime keeps the same checkpoint and sentiment gate, but raises the PVA blend to 0.32, lifts J-state overlay to 0.19, keeps minimum leverage scale at 0.40, and raises buy-dip strength to 0.95 after the 2026-05-24 cap-0.20 re-optimization sequence. S-state drift boost remains disabled.

group_a_inverse_hedge_config.note: 00632R is treated as a short hedge and is forcibly exited when M state ends or max holding days is reached.

execution_timing.note: Signals use day-t data, trades execute at next trading day's open, and performance is marked at next close.

group_a_dca_config.note: Group A DCA is applied only during evaluation/backtest, not PPO training reward.

runtime_overlay_refine.note: Defensive cap-0.20 payload inherits the same checkpoint from the cap-0.30 production profile, lowers the 00631L leverage cap to 0.20, and then runs a dedicated three-stage local re-optimization. The focused and micro sweeps converged on the same best candidate, so the selected overrides below are the finalized cap-0.20 runtime settings. DCA day remains 20.
runtime_overlay_refine.selected_by: highest scored eligible candidate from the 2026-05-24 cap-0.20 focused re-optimization, confirmed unchanged by the final micro pass
